readerCopy.body: Authority can call something non-negotiable at the same moment compliance becomes more costly than refusal. When Saturn opposes Lilith, structure and autonomy face each other directly through a boss, institution, family role, contract, or long-standing obligation. Some rules protect something worth protecting; others survive because the cost of challenging them falls on the person with less power. The conflict becomes clearer once the purpose of the rule, the available negotiation, and the actual consequence of saying no are separated.
